networks.name: lakeside_tech_desk
networks.description: Ask what the fictional Lakeside Tech Desk does, what sample tickets are waiting, leave a sample work request, or paste a job note for a client-safe status draft.
sample_queries: What does Lakeside Tech Desk do, and which sample tickets are waiting?
Wi-Fi is down at a small office. Please leave a sample work request.

Paste this job note and draft a client-safe status: On site at Maple Street Books. Router power light was amber. Reseated the cable. Guest network name shows again. Printer left offline. No passwords were changed.
Can you email the client and send an invoice for the printer visit?
What can the official Little Oven pizza example help with?

peer_policy.note: The only peer is the official Little Oven pizza example, and only after the visitor agrees. Credentials are not sent there.

agent_mcp.reason: This is a static bundle; a public MCP facade requires an application host.
